entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Firms and financial institutions acting on BTC: ETF issuers, corporate holders, stablecoin issuer...

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Primary business line: etf_issuer / corporate_holder / stablecoin_issuer / research

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high / medium / low influence on BTC price path

entity_types.selection_rule: Any named firm/institution whose allocation, issuance or research causally moves BTC demand or supply
levers: 申购/赎回 ETF 份额披露
发布研究报告影响叙事

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: US government bodies: Fed, Treasury/Executive, Congress, SEC — policy and rulemaking actors

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high / medium / low influence on 2027 BTC price

entity_types.selection_rule: Named state institution with rulemaking, rate-setting or reserve authority bearing on BTC
anti_examples: 已被否决且无后续动议的法案本身
levers: 推动/否决 CLARITY、ARMA、BITCOIN 法案
SEC 出台 Regulation Crypto Assets

entity_types.name: Other
entity_types.description: Supply/demand cohorts without legal personality: long-term holders, miners, sovereign/pension all...
entity_types.selection_rule: Aggregated on-chain or allocator cohort whose net buy/sell behavior moves price

entity_types.name: Platform
entity_types.description: Market infrastructure: spot venues, custody providers, derivatives exchanges
entity_types.selection_rule: Named venue providing price discovery, custody or derivatives for BTC
anti_examples: FRED 数据库（数据来源，非平台主体）

entity_types.name: CryptoAsset
entity_types.description: The forecast target asset and directly linked crypto objects
entity_types.selection_rule: The crypto asset whose USD spot price is the settlement statistic

entity_types.name: DerivativeInstrument
entity_types.description: Dated contracts and ETF vehicles whose prices/flows embed expectations about BTC

attributes.name: last_price_usd
attributes.description: Latest quoted price or net assets

entity_types.selection_rule: Tradable instrument whose flows/price carry forecast signal about BTC at 2027-12-31

entity_types.name: MacroIndicator
entity_types.description: Tracked macro series that constrain the BTC path: rates, M2, VIX, dollar index
entity_types.selection_rule: Named quantitative macro series used as a signpost for the forecast
anti_examples: 无具体序列的新闻评论

entity_types.name: LegislationRule
entity_types.description: Specific laws, bills and rules shaping BTC demand: GENIUS, CLARITY, ARMA, SEC proposals
entity_types.selection_rule: Named statute, bill or regulatory rule with dated status affecting BTC markets

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Source relies on target for custody, venue or price discovery
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 的运营依赖 target 提供的基础设施或授权

edge_types.name: BACKS
edge_types.description: Source supports or champions target's position or adoption
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 公开扶持 target（如发行商为机构配置者提供通道）

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Source competes for the same flows or market share
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 与 target 在同一资金池上竞争（对称关系）

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Source shapes target's behavior, flows, price or expectations
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 的政策/数据/行为影响 target 的资金流或价格

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Source holds rulemaking or oversight authority over target
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 对 target 拥有监管/立法约束权

edge_types.name: INVESTS_IN
edge_types.description: Source allocates capital into target fund, instrument or asset
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 向 target 出资/持有份额，资金由 source 流向 target

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Source provides sell-side liquidity or mined supply to target venue/asset
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 向 target 供应 BTC 流动性/算力供给

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Source limits or caps target's price path or policy space
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 施加约束限制 target 的上行/下行空间

edge_types.name: TRIGGERS
edge_types.description: Source event or rule change catalyzes a demand or price regime shift in target

attributes.name: lag
attributes.description: Expected lag from trigger to effect

edge_types.direction_semantics: source 的事件/生效日触发 target 的资金流或价格反应

edge_types.name: TRACKS
edge_types.description: Source observes or prices the target, providing signal data
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 观测/定价 target 并产出可追踪信号（数据流向 source）

analysis_summary: 该预测问题以 BTC 现货（Coinbase/Kraken 合成价）2027-12-31 收盘价为结算统计，属市场/资产价格类客体问题，但核心驱动来自真实主体：监管与货币政策（Fed、SEC、Congress、Treasury）、机构资金通道（BlackRock、Fidelity、ETF 生态）、供给端群体（长期持有者、矿工、主权/养老金配置者）与市场基础设施（Coinbase、Kraken、Deribit、CME）。本体保留种子四类型（Organization/Government/Other/Platform），并新增 CryptoAsset（结算标的）、DerivativeInstrument（BTCZ27、IBIT 等承载预期的工具）、MacroIndicator（利率/M2/VIX 等信号）、LegislationRule（GENIUS/CLARITY/ARMA 等具名规则）。边类型保留全部七条种子关系，并补充 CONSTRAINS/TRIGGERS（因果族，带 sign/lag/threshold）与 TRACKS（信息族），以刻画 ETF 资金流、减半周期、宏观流动性与立法生效日如何传导到 2027 年末价格。
